# mvcc-btree-store

> Embedded key-value store on a B+tree with MVCC snapshot isolation, first-committer-wins conflict detection and a CRC-checked write-ahead log that survives torn writes Rust crate `trysac-mvcc-btree-store`, library `mvcc_btree_store`, MIT licensed,
> Rust >= 1.88 (edition 2024), standard library only.
